reward_formula: reward = min(1.0, ln(speedup/ref_speedup)/ln(ref_speedup)) if speedup > ref_speedup else 0.0; range [0,1]; speedup == ref_speedup => 0.0 (must EXCEED it to score); speedup >= ref_speedup^2 => 1.0

ref_speedup.metric: median measured ABBA speedup of the ORACLE (reviewer fused-Triton kernel) over the strong baseline, under the SHIPPED verifier and the SHIPPED protocol (5 alternating ABBA pairs per run, per-pair ratio = geomean over the 9 hidden timed cases of baseline_ms/candidate_ms)
ref_speedup.oracle_impl: solution/ceiling_triton_fused.py (reviewer-only, NEVER in the image, NEVER run at scoring)
ref_speedup.independent_cross_check: the pre-migration archived measurement of the SAME oracle on an INDEPENDENT session (794fb895, 2026-07-26) was 2.622678 — 1.6% above this median, i.e. the constant is reproducible across sessions/cards. Using 2.6227 instead would move the oracle reward from 0.5000 to 0.4931.
ref_speedup.caveats: reward.md asks for the median of >= 5 oracle RUNS; this is the median of 3 runs, each of which is itself the median of 5 alternating ABBA pairs (15 paired measurements). Adding runs is cheap (165 s per run) but the observed spread is 1.3%, i.e. +-0.004 of reward.
ref_speedup.legality_check: ref_speedup 2.57993 >= 1.15 (reward.md 出题合法性约束) PASS

shipped_naive_skeleton.reason: speedup_not_above_baseline (gate 5); ABBA early-abort after 1 pair, 20.6 s

strong_baseline.note: by definition; baseline drift vs the calibrated absolute anchor 0.13014 measured at 0.1-0.6%

ref_speedup.hardware_caveat: 此 ref_speedup(=2.5799320719769216)在 H20 上标定;若运行硬件与 H20 不一致(GPU 峰值不同),请先用 oracle 实现 solution/ceiling_triton_fused.py 在本机重新标定该锚点,再计分。

recalibrate_howto.step3_write: 把该中位数写回本文件 ref_speedup.value,并更新 status/calibrated_on
recalibrate_howto.note: verifier 通过 $NEGATIVE_DIR(默认 /opt/negative)定位 ceiling 实现;候选名解析: <mode>.py / <bare>.py / negative_<bare>.py

measured_h20_peak.method: peak = 3-stream fp32 elementwise add over 512 MiB buffers, best of 30 (measured twice in two independent sessions: 3687.3 and 3683.0, a 0.1% spread; the harness denominator is 3687.3 and every calibrated number in this manifest was produced with it); read-bound = vectorised Triton grid-stride reduce over 2 GiB; copy-bound = vectorised Triton grid-stride copy over 1 GiB (torch copy_ reaches only 2082.9); copy-bound page-run = the same copy kernel restricted to shuffled page-sized runs, i.e. the honest achievable ceiling for THIS task's traffic at each page/row geometry

strong_baseline.calibrated_on: NVIDIA H20 2026-07-26 (device-synced timing harness; mean of 4 fresh sub-process measurements measured 0.13253 / 0.13163 / 0.12877 / 0.12761, spread 3.9%)
strong_baseline.reward_noise_floor: baseline-vs-itself measured 0.9965 and 1.0362 in the same session (+-3.6% on the REWARD, which is what matters: the reward divides by a baseline re-measured in the same run, so absolute drift largely cancels); per-case step-time spread within a run 1-5%

gates.no_alias: source buffers overwritten after every scatter, then read back
gates.current_plan: two begin_step calls back to back; the second must win
gates.page_addressing: gather request b through request (b+1)'s PAGES: storage must be addressed by the physical page the block table names, not by (request, position)
gates.pool_footprint: DUAL: live bytes <= 1.10x nominal pool after allocate() AND again after the write phase (a lazily built shadow layout cannot slip past the first check)
gates.peak_alloc: pool budget + working allowance + the harness's own buffers
gates.timing: harness-owned time.perf_counter bracketed by full torch.cuda.synchronize() on both sides of the step (side-stream work cannot escape the window); a CUDA-event pair is reported alongside as a cross-check
